data.name: Ihkam
data.gender_notes: Ihkam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ihkam refers to the state of being steadfast and unyielding. It is derived from the Arabic verb 'hakama', which means 'to establish' or 'to be firm'. In Islamic tradition, Ihkam is considered a virtue that is essential for maintaining faith and striving towards righteousness. The name Ihkam carries the meaning “Perseverance, Firmness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ihkam usually hope their child will grow to embody perseverance, firmness and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ihkam total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
